keyFindings.finding: The repository uses direct links, generated native-runtime outputs and real dialect forks; the recorded resolved-link set is broader than the supplied 200-link scope.
Runtime positions and generators are not uniform; upstream direct .skilled configurability remains unknown.
The launcher, project loaders and root sentinel require a resolvable .opencode namespace.
Indexes, manifests, compiled contracts, runtime state and MCP build output have separate owners and regeneration contracts.
Pre-commit, pre-push and path-filtered workflows scope checks to .opencode and can reject or miss a .skilled-only change.
Codex, Hermes, Pi, OpenCode and Git integrations have user-level state outside the repository.
Relative links can be regenerated, but fixed root identities, generated path data and history/one-commit safety require separate treatment.
Live instructions, packaging contracts, generated prompts and historical records have different rewrite policies.

ruledOutDirections.reason: Operator-supplied evidence says its links resolve to another checkout.
Hermes scanning, OpenCode launcher/root identity and split runtime dialects contradict it.
Generators and gates embed or search for .opencode independently of link targets.
